title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Farmer’s Son
moral: Honesty and good values lead to respect.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a farmer and his son.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a farmer who taught honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The boy finds a bag of coins.
scenes.text: The boy found a bag of coins while working.
scenes.image_prompt: boy finding coins in field cartoon

scenes.text: They asked around to find the owner of the coins.
scenes.image_prompt: father and son asking villagers cartoon

scenes.text: An old man claimed the bag and the boy returned it.
scenes.image_prompt: boy returning coins to old man cartoon

scenes.text: The king rewarded the boy. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding boy while smiling cartoon

story: A boy returned lost coins honestly. His values earned him respect and reward. Vikram said honesty brings respect.
